description:
Diego Arellan once lived as a transgender woman named Jade. For years, he pursued what he thought was freedom—through cosmetic surgeries, hormone therapy, makeup, nightlife, and relationships. But beneath the surface, Diego was battling depression, confusion, and a deep emptiness that no amount of physical change could fix.

He was caught in a cycle of chasing beauty, money, and validation, but never found peace.

Everything changed when Diego encountered the love and Truth of Jesus Christ. God opened his eyes to the deception he had been living under and showed him that his true identity was never found in transitioning—it was found in Christ alone.

Now, Diego boldly shares his story across the world, testifying to the transforming power of the gospel. He has de-transitioned and lives fully as the man God created him to be. His life is a powerful witness that no lie is too strong and no identity is too far gone for the truth of Christ to redeem.

Learn more or connect with Diego at:
🌐 https://linkup.shop/dking

Share this testimony. Someone needs to hear it. 🔁💜

#Detransition #IdentityInChrist #DiegoArellan #CandidTruth
